definition: The complete Bool carrier has exactly false→true and true→false, with the Unit atom true at both labels. Formula denotations are the fixed language, including box, diamond, implication and falsity; they agree at both worlds by structural induction. Language-relative MC holds at each non-reflexive world, while full-predicate MC fails. Identity-predicate admissibility and language-relative world extensionality fail, even though the language is negation-closed.
note: Stipulated mathematical semantics for issue #263, not a historical source attribution or an assertion of metaphysical possibility. A philosophical adoption would require its own pinned source reading.
